_comment: Authoring config for canary-local/tools/gen_boards.py. Each entry turns a vendor STEP (boards/vendor/*.step) into a committed, colour-baked GLB (canary-local/boards/<id>.glb) plus a row in canary-local/devices/boards.json. Geometry facts in boards.json are recomputed from the committed GLB by the same loader the browser uses (tools/glb_facts.mjs), so the JSON can never lie about the mesh. Pinouts are the Canary-relevant pins (from firmware/configs + docs/hardware/bom_*.csv), not the full generic map. Pin `anchor`/`anchors` coordinates and the optional board-level `pads` map are raw GLB millimetres (the viewer re-centres by bbox at load), derived from the committed mesh with tools/pin_anchors.mjs — pad-colour islands, never eyeballed; rows without an confidently-identified feature carry no anchor and render table-only.

boards.name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio open-hardware CAD (STEP). Redistributed here as the board's source of truth for the local viewer; see boards/vendor/README.md. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: 21 x 17.8 mm. ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM, onboard LiPo charger; the Sense expansion adds the OV camera + PDM mic on a stacked B2B board. The WAP build uses the plain-facing pins for chirp, tamper, LED and GNSS.

pads._comment: All 14 castellated pads, from the committed GLB's gold-pad islands (tools/pin_anchors.mjs, #e7c863): two rows of 7 at 2.54 mm pitch, USB-C at -X, +Y component side — so z=+1.76 is the D0–D6 edge and z=-13.98 the power/D10–D7 edge.

pinout.label: Status RGB LED
pinout.use: External WS2812 — pin defined but not driven by canary-wap firmware yet; the live indicator is the onboard LED (GPIO21).

pinout.label: Tamper
pinout.use: Reed / hall switch (INPUT_PULLUP, active-low) — FEATURE_TAMPER_GPIO defined but not yet consumed by canary-wap firmware.

pinout.label: Battery
pinout.use: JST-PH LiPo, charged by the onboard charger

boards.name: Seeed Grove Vision AI V2
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio CAD (STEP) supplied with a printable stand + camera shroud + adapter and a posed OV5647 camera. The generator drops the mount parts AND the loose camera by name (mounting_plate, camera_mounting_shroud, adapter, rpi cam) — the camera rides a flex and is posed per-device by the models, not welded to the board. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: Himax WiseEye2 HX6538 (Arm Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55 NPU) with a XIAO host stacked on its socket. Talks to the host over I2C on the Grove connector; the OV5647 camera hangs on the CSI flex and is placed by each device model (it is not rigid to the board). Mount parts and the loose camera from the source assembly are filtered out.

pinout.label: Grove I2C
pinout.use: Sensor bus to the host — the GPIOs depend on the host board: DevKit-C3 4/5, XIAO-C3 6/7 (D4/D5), XIAO-S3 5/6 (D4/D5).

boards.name: Seeed Round Display for XIAO
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio CAD (SolidWorks STEP export). This export did not carry per-solid colours through the tessellator, so materials are assigned by geometry (dark PCB + grey glass); the shape is the vendor's exact model. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: Ø 43.0 mm PCB disc (the “39 mm” in marketing copy is the glass), 1.28-in GC9A01 (240x240) with CST816S touch, PCF8563 RTC, microSD and a LiPo charger; it seats a XIAO on its back socket. The backlight on D6/GPIO43 is PWM-dimmable — that is the bedside night floor.
